inventory.title: Inventory
inventory.description: Raw materials, how much is left and what is running low. Every sale takes its recipe when it goes to the kitchen.
inventory.listHint: Those at or under their alert level come first, in red.
inventory.empty: No raw materials yet. Create the first one, for example «Beef» in kilos.
inventory.noLocation: Choose a location above to see the stock.
inventory.unitFixed: The unit cannot be changed later.
inventory.thresholdHint: At this amount or less it shows «Running low». Leave empty for no alert.
inventory.deleteText: It is hidden; its movements stay in the history.
inventory.inUse: A recipe uses this raw material. Remove it from the recipe or deactivate it.

card.label: Running low
card.detail: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing running low} one {raw material at its alert level} other {raw materials at their alert level}}

hints.purchase: What came from the supplier. Added to the stock.
hints.waste: What was lost: expired, damaged, dropped. Taken from the stock.
hints.adjustment: Corrects the stock. Use a negative number to subtract.
hints.count: What there is now according to a physical count. The system stores the difference.

history.title: History of «{name}»
history.movementsHint: Purchases, waste, adjustments and counts, newest first.
history.daysHint: What sales and kitchen waste (voided dishes already prepared) took.
history.noDays: Nothing with this raw material has been sold yet.

steps.title: How the stock works
steps.oneText: What you buy: meat in kg, beer in litres, bread by the piece.
steps.twoText: In the Menu, «Recipe» tab: what one portion uses.
steps.threeText: When a dish goes to the kitchen, the stock goes down by itself.

recipes.title: Recipes
recipes.description: Every recipe at a glance. A dish's recipe is easiest to edit in the Menu, «Recipe» tab; the recipes of add-on options, here.
recipes.productsHint: A variant with its own recipe replaces the dish's; otherwise it uses the dish's.
recipes.modifiersHint: Added to the dish's recipe, for example «extra fries».
recipes.missing: {count, plural, one {# dish without a recipe} other {# dishes without a recipe}}
recipes.dialogHint: Amounts for one unit sold. Changes apply from now on: what was sold stays.
recipes.noIngredients: Create raw materials in Inventory first.

inline.title: Recipe of «{name}»
inline.hint: What one portion sold uses. When the dish goes to the kitchen, it comes off the stock.
inline.emptyHint: Add what this dish uses. If a raw material is missing, create it right here.
inline.newIngredientHint: It goes into the stock and into this recipe.
inline.portions: {count, plural, one {Enough for # portion} other {Enough for # portions}}
inline.variantHint: Fill it in only if the variant uses different quantities.
inline.variantEmpty: Without its own recipe, the dish's recipe applies.
inline.missingIngredient: Choose a raw material on each line or remove the line.
